name: All Elite Wrestling: Rampage
description: AEW: Rampage, also known as Friday Night Rampage or simply Rampage, is a professional wrestling television program.  It is produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW) and airs every Friday at 10pm ET on TNT in the United States. It is AEW's second weekly television show, positioned behind their flagship show, Dynamite.

videos.title: August 13, 2021 (Pittsburgh, PA)
videos.overview:
AEW Rampage is an electrifying new show featuring the hottest stars of today and tomorrow showcasing their athleticism, charisma and creativity on the fastest rising stage in all of professional wrestling. The gripping one-hour show brings new content, match-ups and personalities to fans every Friday night at 10pm ET live on FITE!

On August 13th is the the debut of AEW Rampage straight from Petersen Events Center, in Pittsburgh, PA! The event is hosted by Chris Jericho, Mark Henry, Excalibur and Taz.

In her hometown, AEW Women's Champion Britt Baker defends her title against Red Velvet. AEW World Champion Kenny Omega will also be in action!
